test_navigate_to_search.title: Verify clicking Search nav link loads the Global Search page

steps.action: Click Search in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The address ends in /search and the Category, Description, Locations & Cameras and Duration filters each read Select.

test_search_page_filters_visible.title: Verify all filter dropdowns are present on the Search page

steps.action: Click Search in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The Category, Locations & Cameras and Duration filters are shown.

test_select_category.title: Verify the Category dropdown opens and a category is selectable

steps.action: Open Search and pick Person in the Category dropdown.
steps.expected: The Category box reads Person and the Description box switches to Appearance with 0 choices.

test_select_duration.title: Verify the Duration dropdown opens and Today is selectable

steps.action: Open Search and pick Today from the Duration dropdown.
steps.expected: The Duration box reads today's range, from 12:00:00 AM on today's date to the present minute.

test_select_locations_cameras.title: Verify Locations & Cameras dropdown opens and site is selectable

steps.action: Open Search and pick the configured site under Locations & Cameras.
steps.expected: The Locations & Cameras box names the first camera and how many more are selected.

test_search_button_visible.title: Verify the search button is disabled until the filters allow a search

steps.expected: The search button shows its disabled icon.

steps.action: Pick Person, Today and the configured site.
steps.expected: The search button shows its enabled icon.
